work: Walter L. Buller, A History of the Birds of New Zealand, 1st ed. (London: John van Voorst, 1873), 1 vol. issued in 5 parts, royal quarto, hand-coloured lithographs
plate: unnumbered (bound between pp. 86 and 87; Alexander Turnbull Library ref. PUBL-0134-087, 'opp. p. 87')
common_name_note: English name from Buller's text heading '(TUI OR PARSON BIRD.)'; only the Latin name is lettered on the plate
artist_credit_on_plate: Keulemans' monogram in the image and scale mark '3/4' (no artist or printer line lettered on this copy).
copy: Natural History Museum Library, London copy, digitised for the Biodiversity Heritage Library (Internet Archive NHM243352)
bhl_note: BHL blocks scripted access, so no BHL page id was looked up; the Smithsonian copy (IA historyofbirdsof00bull) lacks this plate
licence: Public domain (published 1873; artist died 1912; IA: 'Out of copyright'; Wikimedia Commons: PD-old)
processing: JP2 -> RGB, cropped to the plate leaf (box 80,130,2960,4070; drops the scanner background and the facing text page), resized to 900 px tall (Lanczos), JPEG quality 85 (tools/make_plate.py)
